summary: Vale S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter and nine-month 2026 interim financial statements (IFRS/BRGAAP) for the periods ended September 30, 2026. The filing is an earnings release, not a special situation: net operating revenue of R$54,462 million for the quarter versus R$56,701 million a year earlier, gross profit of R$13,664 million, and net income attributable to Vale shareholders of R$6,436 million (basic EPS R$1.51). No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. No deal-related risk-arb angle applies.
